description: Non material amendment to allow:Amendment to balcony sizes Amendment to window dimensions Alignment of ground floor windows with windows aboveAmendment to ground floor louvresAmendment to substation access and layouts Rationalisation of roof top plants L17 and L30 Amendment of L30 louvre extent to suit calculated acoustic requirementsAlteration to external levels to allow access to building levels whilst maintaining planning approved maximum heights and aligning to the existing site boundary levels Amendment to parapets height to meet 1100mm minimum requirement Amendment to floor heights to ensure ground floor heights meet minimum heights of 2500mm finished floor to ceilingAmendment to wall build ups to comply with U-values, Psi values and structural requirementsAmendments incorporated to reflect BS9991 requirements Block B Entrance setback and levels amended to allow accessibility via ramps and stairsAlterations to landscaping of Full Planning Permission application reference 24/1841 dated 18/12/2025 for Demolition of the existing building and redevelopment of the site with a residential-led (Use Class C3) building with flexible commercial/community floorspace (Use Class E/F) at ground level; new basement excavation; cycle stores and blue badge parking; refuse stores and plant rooms/equipment; hard and soft landscaping including part-naturalisation of the Wealdstone Brook; new play space; and all associated engineering and ancillary works and subject to a Deed of Agreement dated 18 December 2025 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended
